$comment: Every dollar figure the course's figures use for one tax year. A new year is a new file (rules-2027.json) with the same shape, switched on in src/engine/rules.ts. Sources are listed per section; numbers marked 'check' were taken from secondary summaries because the IRS, SSA and CMS sites could not be reached from the build machine, and are to be confirmed in the fact check.

federal.source: IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32 (Oct 2025), as summarised by the Journal of Accountancy and CPA Practice Advisor, 9-10 Oct 2025

extra65.note: check: additional standard deduction per person 65 or older

seniorDeduction.note: the 2025 budget act's deduction for each person 65 or older

accounts.source: IRS Notice 2025-67 and Rev. Proc. 2025-19, as summarised by Kiplinger and TaxSlayer; check

aca.source: IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-25 applicable percentages and the 2025 HHS poverty guidelines (used for 2026 coverage), as summarised by healthinsurance.org and The Finance Buff; the enhanced credits of 2021-2025 expired, so the 400% cliff is back; check

sampleBenchmark.note: a sample second-lowest silver premium for a 45-year-old in King County, a year; illustrative only

socialSecurity.source: SSA 2026 COLA fact sheet (Oct 2025) and bend points, as summarised by Finance Wonk and Financialist; check bend points

medicare.source: CMS 2026 Part B premium and IRMAA tables, as summarised by Kiplinger and irmaacalcs.com; check

irmaa.note: each row: MAGI above which the tier starts, then the monthly Part B and Part D surcharge per person

washington.source: Washington Department of Revenue, as summarised by Fulcrum and Brickley Wealth; check the 2026 deduction

portugal.source: Portuguese State Budget 2026 (OE 2026) as summarised by taxclara.pt and jurisdb.org; check against Article 68 CIRS
portugal.note: the first and last thresholds and the rates are as the sources give them; the middle thresholds are the 2025 ones raised by the budget's 3.51 percent, which reproduces both ends; check. Rates are marginal on taxable income after the specific deduction
portugal.pensionDeductionNote: check: the specific deduction for pensions, 8.54 times the IAS (537.13 euros in 2026)
portugal.eurPerDollarNote: an assumed exchange rate for the figures, about $1.15 to the euro
portugal.d7Note: D7 visa: the 2026 minimum wage a month for the main applicant, plus 50 percent for a spouse; check with the consulate
